values.task_boundary: Deliver behavior-preserving cleanup with exact deletion denominator.
deliverables: behavior-preserving cleanup with exact deletion denominator
reviewed deletion manifest, parity proof, and retained-surface inventory
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The execution SHA proves WP-20 ancestry, rollback-window expiry, rollback disposition, selector health, and a clean supported install before deletion.
AC-2: Every remaining adl/src file and active reverse reference has exactly one accountable disposition with replacement evidence or a timed owner/reason/expiry exception.
AC-3: The supported adl command resolves to the thin ADL v2 CLI; Runtime v2 and obsolete compatibility routes are absent only after positive, negative, artifact, trace, failure, and rollback parity.
AC-4: Exact physical LoC/file accounting against the pinned 355,675-line baseline proves at least 80% deletion; 80-89% retention has owner, reason, and expiry, and below 80% is failure.
AC-5: Focused replacement, clean-install, reverse-reference, macOS, Linux, and rollback proof passes at the exact deletion head without unsupported behavior loss.
AC-6: One exact-head independent review has no unresolved actionable finding and the PR uses Closes #5786 without claiming WP-21A or release completion.
repo_inputs: Live issue #5786 objective, rollback gate, baseline, and acceptance criteria
non_goals: Deleting before 2026-08-12T09:04:24Z or while rollback/selector health is unresolved
Treating crate movement, build exclusion, or unowned compatibility retention as reduction
